privacy_meta_description: Information about personal data processing, website access, correspondence and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy_controller_p1: For enquiries concerning your personal data, please contact me at {#link}{email}{/link}.
privacy_access_p1: When you visit this website, your browser establishes a connection with the web server. Technical information, including your IP address and the requested resource, is processed to deliver the website to your device.
privacy_access_p2: This information is processed temporarily during the connection. The website does not maintain access logs or retain records of individual visits.
privacy_access_p3: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is the reliable delivery and operation of the website.
privacy_technologies_p1: This website does not use cookies, analytics services, visitor tracking or advertising technologies.
privacy_communication_p1: When you contact me by email or telephone, I process the contact details and information you provide to respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, discuss or carry out an advisory engagement.
privacy_communication_p2: Where communication concerns a requested service or an existing contractual relationship, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other enquiries are processed under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on my legitimate interest in responding to correspondence.
privacy_communication_p3: You are under no obligation to contact me. If you do, I need sufficient contact information to respond to your enquiry.
privacy_services_p1: I use Gmail, a service provided by Google, to receive, send and store email correspondence.
privacy_services_p2: Correspondence processed through Gmail may be handled on Google's infrastructure outside the European Economic Area. Google describes its data processing and international transfer safeguards in its {#link}Privacy Policy{/link}.
privacy_disclosure_p1: An advisory engagement may require communication with motor-car owners, sellers, dealers, archives or independent specialists.
privacy_disclosure_p2: We will discuss what information about you and your requirements needs to be shared with these parties before making enquiries on your behalf. Depending on the engagement, recipients may be located in Europe or the United States.
privacy_retention_p1: I retain correspondence and related information for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry or carry out an advisory engagement.
privacy_retention_p2: Where statutory retention obligations apply, the relevant information is retained for the required period. Information may also need to be retained where necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
privacy_retention_p3: Otherwise, personal data is deleted when it is no longer required for the purpose for which it was collected.
privacy_rights_p1: Under the GDPR, you may have the right to request:
privacy_rights_objection: objection to processing based on legitimate interests.
privacy_rights_p2: You can exercise these rights by contacting me at {#link}{email}{/link}.
privacy_decisions_p1: No automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR is carried out in connection with website visits or enquiries.
privacy_complaints_p1: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
privacy_complaints_p2: The supervisory authority responsible for Berlin is the {#link}Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit{/link}.
